d: The Staff Nurse is accountable to the Unit Charge Nurse for the delivery of high-quality care of the patients at Dallah Hospital. The post holder is responsible for ensuring attainment of agreed clinical standards and professional development supported by colleagues and the Director of Nursing.

During the time period for which she is responsible, assesses the overall needs of the individual patients, assists in preparation and implements the nursing care process as indicated to ensure optimal patient care.
q: 1 - 2 years post-basic experience, six months of which must be in the specialty.
Previous experience in Middle Eastern healthcare.
Appropriate qualification and statutory nursing registration in the country from where recruited. BSN / RN.
Post-basic course qualification in the specialty.
adaptability, honest, Integrity responsible and trustworthy, respect for patients confidentiality, compassionate AND approachable, strong work ethic, punctual self-confidence, self-motivated
r: Assists physician in conducting patient examinations and provide routine treatments.
Obtains specimen for testing, conducts select routine laboratory tests, and records result.
Performs initial assessment and appropriate plan of care and relays information to physician.
Contact various department personnel throughout the clinic when ordering supplies, obtaining patient medical records, and etc.
Performs related clinical duties such as compiling patient chart information and responds to routine patient inquiries and telephone calls.

Under direction from the physician, performs tests and procedures on patient following established procedures. In doing so, performs ear washers, obtains throat cultures, vaccines and injections, and etc.
Ensures patient chart information is prepared prior to patient admission.
Obtains patient medical records, and inserts appropriate notes, forms and test results.
Maintains continuity of care during take-over and handover reports, ensuring that the communication is clear and accurate at all times.
Ensures that doctors' orders and patient management plans are followed and that appropriate steps are taken.
Ensures that the appropriate records of the patients progress are maintained according to the hospital policies and procedures.
Ensure the safety of the patient, relatives and staff. Reporting untoward incident / accident / staff sickness to the Sister / Charge Nurse.
Maintain current knowledge of medications and their correct administration based on age and patient clinical conditions. Reports adverse reaction to medicines.
Take an active role in the prevention and control of infection.
Contribute to the induction of new staff acting as a mentor when appropriate.
Participate in the Quality Improvement Program within his / her area of responsibilities.
Be committed to further development of own clinical skills and knowledge actively seeking learning opportunities as appropriate.

Ensures that the record of all drugs, IV fluids, etc, is up-to-date as required by the Pharmacy, and ensures that the rules and regulations governing the administration, storage and custody all of drugs are strictly observed at all times.

Maintain skill and knowledge in using various medical devices such as ECG machine, Defibrillator, CTG machine, Electronic fetal monitors, Gynae instruments and other equipment / machine used in the Department.
Maintain skills and knowledge by participating various nursing education programs, in-service training, nursing symposium, workshops & etc.
Ensure that the necessary financial records are maintained for the Finance Department.
Staff should be competent as follows
To obtain and interpret on a 12-lead electrocardiogram.
To administer oxygen, nebulizer and aerosol treatments according to policy.
Complies with the nursing practice standard related to immunization.
To be able to tests visual acuity utilizing instruments provided.
To be able to safely applies / adapts / removes orthopedic cast.
To be able to take actions to prevent patient falls.
To promotes healthy, independent behaviors through the education process.
Ability to give Medications Safely via all routes and relevant to age group and vulnerability of patients according to area of practice.

Participate in patient and family education to help patients and families to better understand and participate in their care and make well informed care decisions. This job description is not an exhaustive list of accountabilities and activities. Job incumbents may be required to perform additional job-related tasks and duties as assigned.

d: تعلن شركة سوبرا للمحاماة والاستشارات القانونية عن توفر فرصة وظيفية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة الرياض بمسمى محامٍ مرخص.
نبحث عن محامٍ يمتلك خبرة عملية راسخة، وقدرة على التعامل مع المسائل القانونية بكفاءة واستقلالية، وتقديم حلول قانونية عملية تراعي احتياجات العملاء وأهدافهم.
إعداد وصياغة ومراجعة العقود والاتفاقيات والمذكرات القانونية.
إدارة ومتابعة القضايا والمنازعات والملفات القانونية.
تمثيل العملاء أمام المحاكم والجهات القضائية وشبه القضائية والجهات ذات العلاقة.
إجراء البحوث القانونية وتحليل الأنظمة واللوائح والمستجدات التشريعية.
المشاركة في الاجتماعات والمفاوضات والتواصل المهني مع العملاء.
مهارات متقدمة في التحليل والاستدلال القانوني.
قدرة عالية على البحث القانوني والوصول إلى الحلول العملية.
مهارات التفاوض والتواصل وإدارة العلاقة مع العملاء.
القدرة على إدارة الملفات والأولويات والعمل باستقلالية.
إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية تعد ميزة تفضيلية.
ترخيص ساري لمزاولة مهنة المحاماة في المملكة العربية السعودية.
خبرة مهنية لا تقل عن 4 سنوات.
مؤهل جامعي في القانون أو الأنظمة أو الشريعة أو تخصص ذي صلة.
خبرة عملية متميزة في ممارسة الأعمال القانونية.
يتم التقديم مباشرة عبر LinkedIn من خلال الإعلان الوظيفي، مع إرفاق السيرة الذاتية المحدثة.
